  "cells": [
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "# Exploring and Cleaning the Kenya Healthcare Facilities Dataset\n",
        "\n",
        "## Project Overview\n",
        "\n",
        "Healthcare data often contains missing values, duplicate records, inconsistent formats, and other quality issues that can negatively affect data analysis and machine learning models.\n",
        "\n",
        "This notebook focuses on exploring, understanding, and cleaning the Kenya Healthcare Facilities dataset. The cleaned dataset will later be merged with another dataset containing healthcare services offered by various facilities across Kenya.\n",
        "\n",
        "The objective of this notebook is to ensure that the healthcare facilities dataset is accurate, consistent, and ready for integration. By performing exploratory data analysis (EDA) and data cleaning, we aim to identify data quality issues, understand the characteristics of the dataset, and produce a reliable dataset for subsequent analysis.\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "## Objectives\n",
        "\n",
        "The main objectives of this notebook are to:\n",
        "\n",
        "- Explore the structure and contents of the dataset.\n",
        "- Understand the meaning and distribution of the available features.\n",
        "- Identify missing values, duplicate records, and inconsistent data.\n",
        "- Detect invalid entries and potential outliers.\n",
        "- Clean and prepare the dataset for merging with the healthcare services dataset.\n",
        "- Export a cleaned version of the dataset for downstream analysis.\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "## Team contribution\n",
        "\n",
        "As part of our capstone project at Ngao Labs, this notebook focuses specifically on the exploration and preparation of the healthcare facilities dataset.\n",
        "\n",
        "The cleaned dataset produced in this notebook will serve as one of the primary inputs during the data integration stage, where it will be merged with another cleaned dataset containing healthcare services offered by healthcare facilities.\n",
        "\n",
        "Producing a high-quality dataset before merging helps improve the reliability, consistency, and accuracy of the final integrated dataset."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "09KJKuBHeiCO"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "execution_count": null,
      "metadata": {

        "# Step 3: Understanding the dataset structure\n",
        "\n",
        "## Objective\n",
        "\n",
        "The objective of this step is to examine the overall structure of the dataset by determining its dimensions, identifying the available variables, and reviewing their data types.\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "## Why is this important?\n",
        "\n",
        "Understanding the structure of a dataset is a fundamental step in exploratory data analysis (EDA). It provides an overview of the number of observations, the available features, and the type of information stored in each column.\n",
        "\n",
        "This assessment also helps identify potential data quality issues, such as missing values, incorrect data types, or unexpected variables that may require cleaning before further analysis."
      ],

        "# Step 4: Missing value analysis\n",
        "\n",
        "## Objective\n",
        "\n",
        "The objective of this step is to identify missing values within the dataset and assess their potential impact on the analysis.\n",
        "\n",
        "##  Why is this important?\n",
        "\n",
        "Missing values are common in real-world datasets and can significantly affect the quality of analysis and machine learning models. Identifying missing data helps determine whether variables should be cleaned, imputed, or removed before further processing.\n",
        "\n",
        "A systematic assessment of missing values also provides insight into the completeness and reliability of each feature."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "iwJEeYTvg2fc"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Calculate missing values and percentages\n",
        "\n",
        "missing_values = df.isnull().sum()\n",
        "\n",
        "missing_percentage = (missing_values / len(df)) * 100\n",
        "\n",
        "missing_report = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "    \"Missing Values\": missing_values,\n",
        "    \"Percentage (%)\": missing_percentage\n",
        "})\n",
        "\n",
        "missing_report = missing_report[missing_report[\"Missing Values\"] > 0]\n",
        "\n",
        "missing_report = missing_report.sort_values(\n",
        "    by=\"Percentage (%)\",\n",
        "    ascending=False\n",
        ")\n",

        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",

        "# Top 15 columns with the highest missing values\n",

        "\n",
        "plt.barh(\n",

        "    top_missing[\"Percentage (%)\"]\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Missing Percentage (%)\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Columns\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Top 15 Columns with Missing Values\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.gca().invert_yaxis()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.show()"

        "##  Interpretation\n",
        "\n",
        "The bar chart provides a visual representation of the variables with the highest proportion of missing data.\n",
        "\n",
        "Visualization makes it easier to identify features that may not contribute meaningful information due to excessive incompleteness.\n",
        "\n",
        "Columns with nearly all values missing are strong candidates for removal during the data cleaning stage."

      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "# Step 5: Duplicate analysis\n",
        "\n",
        "## Objective\n",
        "\n",
        "The objective of this step is to identify duplicate records within the dataset and determine whether they represent genuine duplicate entries or inconsistencies that require cleaning.\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "##  Why is this important?\n",
        "\n",
        "Duplicate records are a common data quality issue in real-world datasets. They can distort statistical summaries, bias analytical results, and create problems when merging datasets.\n",
        "\n",
        "Since each healthcare facility should have a unique **Facility ID**, identifying duplicate IDs is particularly important. This ensures that each facility is represented only once before integrating this dataset with the healthcare services dataset."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "QJ7Xb0blizO3"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Count completely duplicated rows\n",
        "\n",
        "duplicate_rows = df.duplicated().sum()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"Number of completely duplicated rows: {duplicate_rows}\")"
      ],

        "##  Key findings\n",

        "The duplicate analysis revealed a significant data quality issue within the dataset.\n",

        "Key observations include:\n",

        "- The dataset contains **17,050 records**.\n",

        "\n",
        "The duplicate records appear to be exact copies rather than conflicting observations. This suggests that the duplication most likely resulted from data export or consolidation\n",

        "Before merging this dataset with the healthcare services dataset, duplicate records should be removed to ensure that each healthcare facility is represented only once.\n",

        "# Step 6: Geographic coordinate validation\n",
        "\n",
        "## Objective\n",

        "KENYA_COUNTIES = {\n",

        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "# Keep the original value for auditing\n",
        "df['County_Original'] = df['County'].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Basic text cleanup\n",
        "df['County'] = (\n",
        "    df['County']\n",
        "    .astype('string')\n",
        "    .str.strip()\n",
        "    .str.replace(r'\\s+', ' ', regex=True)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Optional correction of common spelling variations\n",
        "county_aliases = {\n",
        "    'Homa bay': 'Homa Bay',\n",
        "    'Homabay': 'Homa Bay',\n",
        "    'Taita-Taveta': 'Taita Taveta',\n",
        "    'Tharaka-Nithi': 'Tharaka Nithi',\n",
        "    'Trans-Nzoia': 'Trans Nzoia',\n",
        "    'Elgeyo-Marakwet': 'Elgeyo Marakwet',\n",
        "    'Uasin-Gishu': 'Uasin Gishu',\n",
        "    'Westpokot': 'West Pokot',\n",
        "    \"Murang'a\": 'Muranga',\n",
        "    \"Murang’a\": 'Muranga'\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "df['County'] = df['County'].replace(county_aliases)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Identify valid counties\n",
        "valid_county = df['County'].isin(KENYA_COUNTIES)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Replace everything else with Unknown\n",
        "df.loc[~valid_county, 'County'] = 'Unknown'\n",
        "\n",
        "# ================================================================\n",
        "# RESULTS\n",
        "# ================================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"=\" * 60)\n",

    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "**County Cleaning Findings**\n",
        "\n",
        "The County column was validated against Kenya's 47 official counties. Several unexpected values, such as Ministry of Health, Private Practice - General Practitioner, and Non-Governmental Organizations, were identified as non-county facility attributes.\n",
        "\n",
        "Valid county names were retained, while invalid or non-geographic values were replaced with Unknown. The original values were preserved in County_Original for audit purposes.\n",
        "\n",
        "This ensures the County field contains only valid Kenyan counties or Unknown, improving consistency for subsequent analysis and the AfyaGuide recommendation system."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "5SEsTA5yt_9H"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",

    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "# Step 7: Remove unnecessary columns\n",
        "\n",
        "During exploration, several columns were found to contain almost entirely missing values or accidental metadata introduced during data export.\n",
        "\n",
        "These columns do not provide meaningful information for analysis or machine learning.\n",
        "\n",
        "Removing them improves dataset quality, reduces noise, and simplifies the merging process with the healthcare services dataset."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "8pMbEm2XlssH"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Columns identified as unnecessary\n",
        "\n",
        "columns_to_drop = [\n",
        "    \"0\", \"-\", \"24\",\n",
        "    \"Unnamed: 43\", \"Unnamed: 44\", \"Unnamed: 45\",\n",
        "    \"Unnamed: 46\", \"Unnamed: 47\", \"Unnamed: 48\",\n",
        "    \"Unnamed: 49\", \"Unnamed: 50\", \"Unnamed: 51\",\n",
        "    \"Unnamed: 52\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Drop the unnecessary columns\n",
        "df = df.drop(columns=columns_to_drop)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"New dataset shape:\", df.shape)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "Gnz-AiL1lm1A",
        "outputId": "64296791-7de4-4ad9-fdad-bb456593e4d8"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "New dataset shape: (17050, 41)\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "# Step 8: Remove Duplicate Records\n",
        "\n",
        "During exploration, duplicate healthcare facility records were identified.\n",
        "\n",
        "Duplicate records can:\n",
        "- Bias statistical analysis.\n",
        "- Cause incorrect facility counts.\n",
        "- Affect machine learning model performance.\n",
        "- Lead to duplicate entries after merging datasets.\n",
        "\n",
        "Since each healthcare facility should have a unique **Facility ID**, duplicate records are removed while keeping the first occurrence of each facility."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "nK5Jl60Bl-k-"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Number of rows before removing duplicates\n",
        "print(\"Rows before cleaning:\", len(df))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Remove duplicate Facility IDs\n",
        "df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=\"Facility ID\", keep=\"first\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Number of rows after cleaning\n",
        "print(\"Rows after cleaning:\", len(df))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Number of facilities removed\n",
        "print(\"Duplicate records removed:\", 17050 - len(df))"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "6pMvmflXlyo0",
        "outputId": "4c05e9dd-5eff-447a-9df3-43b5abfefac2"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Rows before cleaning: 17050\n",
            "Rows after cleaning: 12050\n",
            "Duplicate records removed: 5000\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Confirm that every Facility ID is now unique\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Duplicate Facility IDs remaining:\",\n",
        "      df[\"Facility ID\"].duplicated().sum())"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "3RnG5GYkmCzo",
        "outputId": "d574cc4d-09da-4899-b470-ae8a244569cf"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Duplicate Facility IDs remaining: 0\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "### Observation\n",
        "\n",
        "A total of **5,000 duplicate records** were removed based on the unique **Facility ID**.\n",
        "\n",
        "The cleaned dataset now contains **12,050 unique healthcare facilities**, ensuring that each facility appears only once.\n",
        "\n",
        "This step prevents duplicate counting during analysis and guarantees a one-to-one relationship when merging with the healthcare services dataset."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "r_VpTk15mZeK"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "# Step 9: Correct Data Types\n",
        "\n",
        "Several columns were imported as text even though they represent dates, numeric values, or geographical coordinates.\n",
        "\n",
        "Converting these columns to their appropriate data types improves data quality and enables accurate statistical analysis, visualization, and machine learning."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "ZC_JzCMAmfdr"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [

        "date_columns = [\n",

        "    \"Date approved\"\n",

        "\n",
        "for col in date_columns:\n",
        "    df[col] = pd.to_datetime(df[col], errors=\"coerce\")\n",

    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "## 11. Data Quality Assessment and Cleaning Decisions\n",
        "\n",
        "The exploratory analysis identified two major data quality issues within the bed capacity variables.\n",
        "\n",
        "1. Several Level 2 facilities reported implausibly large numbers of inpatient beds, suggesting possible data entry errors.\n",
        "\n",
        "2. A substantial number of facilities reported more general inpatient beds than total inpatient beds. Investigation showed that these inconsistencies were primarily caused by Total In-patient beds being recorded as zero while detailed bed counts were available. This indicates that zero may represent missing or incomplete information rather than an actual bed count.\n",
        "\n",
        "These observations guide the subsequent cleaning decisions."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "jFoIKWiUp4TS"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Bed capacity values greater than 1000 are considered implausible\n",
        "# for Level 2 facilities and are treated as missing.\n",
        "\n",
        "mask = (\n",
        "    (df[\"Keph Level\"] == \"Level 2\") &\n",
        "    (df[\"Total In-patient beds\"] > 1000)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "df.loc[mask, \"Total In-patient beds\"] = pd.NA"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "ouP2oNhIp5Re"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "mask = (\n",
        "    (df[\"Total In-patient beds\"] == 0) &\n",
        "    (df[\"General In-patient beds\"] > 0)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "df.loc[\n",
        "    mask,\n",
        "    \"Total In-patient beds\"\n",
        "] = df.loc[\n",
        "    mask,\n",
        "    \"General In-patient beds\"\n",
        "]"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "rjK2XvdeqChj"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "invalid_beds = df[\n",
        "    df[\"General In-patient beds\"] >\n",
        "    df[\"Total In-patient beds\"]\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Remaining logical inconsistencies:\", len(invalid_beds))"
      ],

            "Remaining logical inconsistencies: 10\n"
          ]
        }
      ]

      "source": [
        "### 11.1 Investigating Remaining Bed Capacity Inconsistencies\n",
        "\n",
        "After correcting records where Total In-patient beds was recorded as zero despite having valid General In-patient bed counts, only a small number of inconsistencies remained.\n",
        "\n",
        "These remaining records are inspected individually to determine whether they result from data entry errors or require manual correction."
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "**Feature engineering **\n",
        "\n",
        "The original dataset contained several bed and theatre variables that provided overlapping information. To reduce redundancy and improve model interpretability, related variables were combined into 10 derived capacity features.\n",
        "\n",
        "The features capture overall inpatient capacity, general care, maternity, emergency, critical care, isolation, theatre availability, specialized capacity, and an overall facility capacity score.\n",
        "\n",
        "The resulting features are:\n",
        "\n",
        "Total_Bed_Capacity\n",
        "General_Care_Capacity\n",
        "Maternity_Capacity\n",
        "Emergency_Capacity\n",
        "Critical_Care_Capacity\n",
        "Isolation_Capacity\n",
        "Total_Theatre_Capacity\n",
        "Maternity_Theatre_Capacity\n",
        "Specialized_Capacity\n",
        "Facility_Capacity_Score\n",
        "\n",
        "This reduces feature redundancy while retaining the information most relevant to assessing a facility's ability to manage different types of health needs."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "55Iw6FdUzE6N"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "\n",
        "# Source columns\n",
        "capacity_columns = [\n",
        "    \"Total In-patient beds\",\n",
        "    \"General In-patient beds\",\n",
        "    \"Cots\",\n",
        "    \"Maternity beds\",\n",
        "    \"Emergency casualty beds\",\n",
        "    \"Intensive Care Unit beds\",\n",
        "    \"High Dependency Unit beds\",\n",
        "    \"Isolation beds\",\n",
        "    \"General theatres\",\n",
        "    \"Maternity theatres\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Convert to numeric\n",
        "for col in capacity_columns:\n",
        "    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(\n",
        "        df[col],\n",
        "        errors=\"coerce\"\n",
        "    ).fillna(0)\n",
        "\n",
        "# ================================================================\n",
        "# CORE CAPACITY FEATURES\n",
        "# ================================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "df[\"Total_Bed_Capacity\"] = (\n",
        "    df[\"Total In-patient beds\"]\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "df[\"General_Care_Capacity\"] = (\n",
        "    df[\"General In-patient beds\"]\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "df[\"Maternity_Capacity\"] = (\n",
        "    df[\"Maternity beds\"] +\n",
        "    df[\"Cots\"]\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "df[\"Emergency_Capacity\"] = (\n",
        "    df[\"Emergency casualty beds\"]\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "df[\"Critical_Care_Capacity\"] = (\n",
        "    df[\"Intensive Care Unit beds\"] +\n",
        "    df[\"High Dependency Unit beds\"]\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "df[\"Isolation_Capacity\"] = (\n",
        "    df[\"Isolation beds\"]\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "df[\"Total_Theatre_Capacity\"] = (\n",
        "    df[\"General theatres\"] +\n",
        "    df[\"Maternity theatres\"]\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "df[\"Maternity_Theatre_Capacity\"] = (\n",
        "    df[\"Maternity theatres\"]\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# ================================================================\n",
        "# COMBINED SPECIALIZED CAPACITY\n",
        "# ================================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "df[\"Specialized_Capacity\"] = (\n",
        "    df[\"Emergency_Capacity\"] +\n",
        "    df[\"Critical_Care_Capacity\"] +\n",
        "    df[\"Isolation_Capacity\"]\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# ================================================================\n",
        "# OVERALL CAPACITY SCORE\n",
        "# ================================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "df[\"Facility_Capacity_Score\"] = (\n",
        "    np.log1p(df[\"Total_Bed_Capacity\"]) +\n",
        "    np.log1p(df[\"Specialized_Capacity\"]) +\n",
        "    np.log1p(df[\"Total_Theatre_Capacity\"])\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# ================================================================\n",
        "# FINAL FEATURES\n",
        "# ================================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "capacity_features = [\n",
        "    \"Total_Bed_Capacity\",\n",
        "    \"General_Care_Capacity\",\n",
        "    \"Maternity_Capacity\",\n",
        "    \"Emergency_Capacity\",\n",
        "    \"Critical_Care_Capacity\",\n",
        "    \"Isolation_Capacity\",\n",
        "    \"Total_Theatre_Capacity\",\n",
        "    \"Maternity_Theatre_Capacity\",\n",
        "    \"Specialized_Capacity\",\n",
        "    \"Facility_Capacity_Score\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"Created {len(capacity_features)} capacity features.\")\n",
        "\n",
        "display(\n",
        "    df[capacity_features].head()\n",
        ")"
      ],

        "## Step 9: Exporting the Clean Dataset\n",
        "\n",
        "After cleaning, validating, and standardizing the dataset, we export the final version for downstream analysis.\n",
        "\n",
        "This cleaned dataset will serve as the master healthcare facilities dataset and will later be merged with the healthcare services dataset using the **Facility ID** as the primary key.\n",
        "\n",
        "Exporting the cleaned dataset ensures that subsequent analyses are reproducible and are based on high-quality data."
